keyEvents.text: Telasco Segovia (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 1, Charlotte FC 0. Ian Fray (Inter Miami CF) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Sergio Reguilón (Inter Miami CF).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Gonzalo Luján replaces Sergio Reguilón because of an injury.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 2, Charlotte FC 0. Luis Suárez (Inter Miami CF) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Germán Berterame following a corner.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 0. Rodrigo De Paul (Inter Miami CF) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Telasco Segovia.
First Half ends, Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 0.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Tyger Smalls replaces Idan Toklomati.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Facundo Mura replaces Ian Fray.
Second Half begins Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 0.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 1. Liel Abada (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Tyger Smalls.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Yannick Bright replaces David Ayala because of an injury.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 2. Liel Abada (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pep Biel.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Matías Galarza replaces Rodrigo De Paul.
Substitution, Inter Miami CF. Riquelme Fillipi replaces Germán Berterame.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Abdoulaye Doucouré replaces Ashley Westwood.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. David Schnegg replaces Harry Toffolo.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Rodolfo Aloko replaces Djibril Diani.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Brandt Bronico replaces Luca de la Torre.
David Schnegg (Charlotte FC) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 3. Rodolfo Aloko (Charlotte FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Second Half ends, Inter Miami CF 3, Charlotte FC 3.
